rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Construct structured gate covers for broad Boolean classes and bound their total joint description cost. An arbitrary DNF representation is only a starting point; prove the quantitative cost of its use.

deliverables.description: STRUCTURED_COVER.tex: constructive representation theorem for a named class
COVER_COST.md: every support, order, root, and gate-label term

acceptance_criteria: Give an algorithm or existence proof constructing admissible gates for every member of the declared class.
Prove the full quantitative joint cost; an arbitrary exponential DNF is not itself a constant-cost representation.
State how the new class extends the published structured classes, and keep any assertion that every Boolean function belongs to it explicitly open.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A quantitatively useful cover for a genuinely broader class, or a rigorous barrier to that proposed cover, supports renewal.

assignments.target_statement: Use the exact activation formula to test whether a rare outer gate hides an arbitrary difficult core. Identify a structural admission condition that is proved, survives needed operations, and excludes this hidden-core construction.

deliverables.description: ACTIVATION_ADMISSION.tex: proved structural condition and closure properties
HIDDEN_CORE_TEST.md: seed embedding under the candidate condition

acceptance_criteria: Use the exact activation H and I formulas, including the entropy term created by the rare selector, before simplifying.
If the condition excludes hidden arbitrary cores, prove the exclusion and specify the remaining class rather than calling it universal.
Verify only the closure operations actually used downstream; do not assume restriction/tensor stability from a root-level property.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A nonvacuous admission condition with a complete class theorem or an embedding that rules it out is a meaningful increment.

assignments.target_statement: Study how a useful ordered cover changes under a physical restriction, tensor product, or multiplexer composition. Bound the extra gates, label entropy, and changes in root probabilities explicitly.

deliverables.description: COVER_STABILITY.tex: restriction, tensor, and multiplexer transformation bounds
STABILITY_LEDGER.json: gate-count, name-entropy, and root-probability changes

acceptance_criteria: Define the transformed cover on each physical child and prove it represents that actual child.
Track selector variables already present in branches; a fresh independent selector hypothesis cannot be asserted after variable reuse.
Show the cumulative overhead under iteration, with explicit examples where an operation fails to preserve the useful class.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One nontrivial stability theorem with a summable cost, or a parameterized stability obstruction, is delivered.

assignments.target_statement: Replace maximum read k by a spectral or fractional congestion quantity. Prove a theorem where k grows but the new quantity remains bounded, and supply an explicit unbounded-overlap example.

deliverables.description: CONGESTION_REFINEMENT.tex: new parameter and FEI theorem
UNBOUNDED_READ_EXAMPLE.md: explicit family separating new and old parameters

acceptance_criteria: Define the spectral/fractional congestion without using H itself or an assumed universal FEI bound as an input.
Exhibit k→∞ while the new quantity remains bounded, and prove all other terms in the theorem remain uniformly controlled.
Compare the resulting H/I bound against the existing logarithmic-k theorem on that same family, including root and rank costs.

Use the recovered K_eff refinement as a baseline where its structural hypotheses hold. Prove the complete expected-cost improvement, including the remaining reference normalizers and Σ_i I_i ln K_eff,i, rather than reprove the multiplier estimate.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A strict, rigorously demonstrated improvement beyond worst-case read is required to continue this packet.

assignments.target_statement: Quantify the dimension term in naive minterm coding on majority, tribes, and sparse activated cores. Prove which compression feature is missing before proposing a universal representation lemma.

deliverables.description: MINTERM_BARRIERS.tex: majority, tribes, and activated-core dimension costs
COMPRESSION_REQUIREMENTS.md: exact information absent from naive descriptions

acceptance_criteria: Derive the order of the minterm name/subset cost separately from the actual Fourier entropy and influence.
Compare at least majority, a parameterized tribes family, and a rare activated arbitrary core with correct normalization.
A missing compression feature is stated as a precise unpaid term; failure of one code is not promoted to failure of all representations.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Freeze the three calibrated barriers and hand one specific missing compression target to A008/A011.
